그 아래로 내려가는 것으로 알고 있습니다.

limitations: ASR confidence is not a calibrated intelligibility score.
The transcript does not identify interviewer and candidate speakers.
This report cannot assess voice quality, emotion, personality, or accent.
Review segment timestamps against the source audio before assigning a voice score.
For this revision, candidate turns were mapped from the supplied transcript labels; pyannote diarization and direct audio listening were not performed.

diarization.note: Candidate turns below were mapped from the user-provided speaker-labeled transcript; no automatic diarization model was run.

manual_speaker_mapping.mapping_rule: Transcript attendee 2 is the interviewee; other numbered attendees are interviewers.
manual_speaker_mapping.confidence: medium; depends on accuracy of supplied speaker labels and timestamps; not independently verified by diarization

segment_speech_rate_distribution.interpretation: Short ASR segment rates are noisy; use as descriptive variation, not a speed grade.

pause_summary.interpretation: Pause intervals are not reliable breath-event detections.

loudness.interpretation: Relative to this recording; microphone gain and distance affect the values.

prosody.reason: Install the optional audio-analysis dependencies for F0 analysis.

limitations: Diarization and temporal alignment may assign short or overlapping turns incorrectly.
Pause intervals do not detect inhalation reliably; do not call them breath counts.
RMS and clipping depend on the recording chain and are not direct measures of speaking quality.
Pitch statistics vary with individual voice and phonetic content; do not use them as universal score thresholds.
